name: ShadowTLS
summary: Foreground service guidance for ShadowTLS, with host-checked networking capacity limits.

recommendations.reason: tired capacity policy for Linux networking workloads; apply only within the observed usable ceiling.
tired capacity policy for Linux networking workloads; apply only within the observed usable ceiling.

advisories.message: Preserve global options before the client/server subcommand and keep the selected mode arguments. ShadowTLS may require a separately managed proxy backend.
Certificate/SNI, backend connectivity and authentication are application concerns. Low-port binding requires explicit account or capability choices.

The 1048576 descriptor pair is a capacity policy, not a measured connection guarantee. Unknown or lower host/manager ceilings suppress it. Review an explicit lower --nofile SOFT:HARD value if needed; global limits are never raised.

The existing on-failure restart policy and delay remain in effect unless explicitly changed. Finite commands need --restart no; long-running modes still need application health and capacity monitoring.
Basename matching does not authenticate the executable, version or build. Preserve the original arguments, working directory and explicit user choices.
